sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The accusative suffix -t marks the direct object. Some words take -t directly, others need a linking vowel first — -ot/-et/-öt depending on vowel harmony — to make the ending pronounceable.
narancs → narancsot needs the linking -o- because two consonants would otherwise collide. tojás already ends in a vowel-friendly consonant, so tojás → tojást needs no linking vowel.
